search_jobs.description: Search open tech jobs on freehire, gathered from companies' own career pages and job boards. Every filter is optional: narrow by keywords, location, work mode, seniority, skills, role, company, salary and how recently the job was listed. Each job comes with its salary, skills, a link to apply and a plain-text description.

description: Search open tech jobs with freehire, the open-source job search engine that gathers postings from companies' own career pages. Find jobs by keywords, location, remote work, seniority, skills, salary and visa sponsorship; count the market by any of them; look up companies; and start a workflow when a new job matches a search. No account or API key required.

freehire_new_job_trigger.description: Starts a run for each new job on freehire that matches your search, as soon as freehire finds it. Jobs already listed when the workflow is turned on don't start runs.
